description: Add support for date-based reward conditions that allow targeting customers based on their signup date and subscription start date. These dates should be available in reward evaluation contexts and partner commission payloads, with appropriate UI components for configuring date conditions.
functional_requirements: Add customer signupDate and subscriptionStartDate fields to the reward evaluation context and partner commission payloads
Implement date condition type with date-specific comparison operators (before, after, on, between)
Create UI components including DatePicker and date-aware inputs for editing date-based reward conditions in the rewards configuration interface
Format date/time values in tooltips and condition displays for better user readability
Ensure date conditions work correctly with existing reward evaluation logic and sale tracking flows
Add comprehensive tests for date-based reward conditions including unit tests and end-to-end sale reward scenarios
